events.what_it_is: Grand-opening day for NAYA's Park Slope location, advertised as the brand's 50th location.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests receive a free bowl, roll, or salad. After the first 100, bowls, rolls, and salads are advertised at $5 for the rest of opening day.
events.caveats: The free meal is limited to the first 100 guests and is therefore while supplies last. Current public listings describe the opening as open to the public; no RSVP requirement was published in the sources verified in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16 from 10:30 AM–9 PM at 311 7th Ave in Park Slope. Arrive before opening if the first-100 free meal is the priority.

events.event_name: CookUnity The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N’ Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas with eight chefs serving complimentary signature dishes, hot bites, take-away meals and bodega-style scratch-off tickets.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary CookUnity chef-made meals and hot bites while supplies last, plus a scratch-off ticket for chances to win CookUnity meals and dining experiences.
events.caveats: Open to the public with no RSVP requirement found. Food is explicitly while supplies last; current coverage recommends arriving before the 11:30 AM start because lines are expected.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan bodegas in Chelsea, Flatiron, Midtown, Murray Hill and the West Village.

events.what_it_is: A free immersive cat-themed bodega pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with photo moments, games, product sampling and merchandise prizes.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree samples; visitors can also play claw-machine and scratch-off games for chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: Mars/TEMPTATIONS describes the physical NYC activation as free. Samples and merchandise prizes are promotional and should be treated as subject to availability; no RSVP requirement was published in the verified first-party announcement.
events.practical_notes: September 17–19, daily 12–6 PM at 213 Bowery. This is the physical NYC activation; the separate virtual Cat Bodega runs through September 26.
